change_summary: Keep exact continuation owners authoritative before broad search so lexical matches from unrelated Projects cannot replace the user's current subject.

canonical_skill.note: The Skill keeps host handoff weak while making exact continuation identity precede broad lexical discovery.

server_contract.note: The shared contract advances for subject-preserving continuation across MCP, Skill and Host context.

package_manifests.note: Plugin and Skill manifests advance together to 1.7.34 with collaboration contract 2026-09-13.9.

workspace_cli.note: The CLI consumes the server-owned collaboration contract and needs no command or package change.

help_center.note: Public guidance explains that exact continuation owners precede broad search and unrelated lexical hits remain candidates.

package_setup.note: OAuth, MCP endpoint and package installation steps are unchanged.

harness_and_mainline.note: The external Host harness now carries prior-turn handles as subject authority without adding Case-specific desired content.

external_marketplaces.note: The official package publication is first-party; external directory review and full independent Claude longitudinal acceptance remain separate evidence.

release_evidence.note: Focused tests cover subject-preserving continuation in Host context, Skill/package metadata, shared contract and public projections.
